about_the_game:
"Those images... they're all in my head. It's like they're coming from everyone's hearts, and I'm watching it all."

Key Features

  • Unique "Mind-Probing" Mechanic: Say goodbye to traditional clue-hunting. Instead, you'll "peek into people's hearts." By observing the bizarre and fantastical images that appear in the characters' minds, you'll uncover unexpected clues and plot twists.

  • A Hilarious and Witty Storyline: Dunkadoo's investigative process will have you laughing out loud! The game is packed with absurd dialogue, comical character interactions, and unpredictable plot developments that will keep you entertained from start to finish.

  • A Cast of Distinctive Characters: From peculiar suspects to eccentric witnesses, every character has their own unique mental world, just waiting for you to discover their inner "dramas."

  • Hand-Drawn Art Style: The game's distinct hand-drawn art style perfectly captures the absurdity and fun of the detective world, with every frame looking like a story-filled illustration.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft® Windows® 7 SP1
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10-compatible graphics card with at least 1GB of video memory
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 7 GB available space

short_description: Dunkadoo Detective is the funniest mystery game. Dunkadoo, a newly-minted supermarket detective, must face threats from a mysterious caller. With the help of a box-dog with special powers, Dunkadoo searches for clues and uses his small brain to solve big problems!
